product_from_film: Mark II combines a bookmark and a small scanner/voice recorder with a phone library for reading quotes and ideas.
explains_well: Hands using the two physical parts explain how the device belongs with a book, while the app shows quotes linked to books.
unclear: The film never clearly follows the same scanned passage and spoken thought into their saved app record, leaving the capture-to-library link implicit.
scenario: Save a passage and a personal thought while reading a printed book, then find them later in a phone library.
product_clear_basis: The founder introduces Mark II, followed by scanning, speaking into the device and a phone library.
